model_annotation: This pie chart represents a breakdown of categories related to chemical entities and disease classifications. The chart contains sixteen distinct slices, each representing a different category; the largest slice, colored blue, represents “Chemical Family” at approximately 37%, followed by “Disease” at approximately 33% and “Cell Type” at approximately 25%. The remaining slices, colored in shades of pink, purple, and orange, represent categories such as “Drug,” “Frequency,” “Drug Use,” “Genetic Or Gene Product,” “Gene By Gene Product,” “Strength”, “Disease Of Genetic Product”, “Form”, “Sequence Entity”, “Sequence Variant”, “Chemical Entity”, “Reason” , “Specific Disease” and “Other” with proportions estimated to be around 5% to 8% each. Percentages are displayed within each slice, and a legend is present identifying each category by its respective color. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in size.
